claims: Saturday Night Live's 2025-2026 season is Season 51.
Kenan Thompson is in his 23rd season on Saturday Night Live.
Colin Jost and Michael Che are Weekend Update anchors on Saturday Night Live.
Ben Marshall was formerly of Please Don't Destroy.

The returning repertory players for Saturday Night Live Season 51 are Kenan Thompson, Colin Jost, Michael Che, Mikey Day, Andrew Dismukes, Chloe Fineman, Marcello Hernández, James Austin Johnson, Sarah Sherman, and Bowen Yang.
The returning featured players for Saturday Night Live Season 51 are Ashley Padilla and Jane Wickline.
The new featured players who joined in Fall 2025 for Saturday Night Live Season 51 are Tommy Brennan, Jeremy Culhane, Ben Marshall, Kam Patterson, and Veronika Slowikowska.
Notable exits ahead of Saturday Night Live Season 51 included Heidi Gardner, Ego Nwodim, Michael Longfellow, Devon Walker, and Emil Wakim.
Ben Marshall joined the main cast of Saturday Night Live.
Martin Herlihy moved to the writing staff of Saturday Night Live.
John Higgins departed Saturday Night Live.
Saturday Night Live continues its 51st season in early 2026.
Saturday Night Live marks its 1000th episode in January 2026.
